message.content:
This editorial illustration for the magazine Tempo features a space scene against a black star-filled background with Earth’s blue curvature at the bottom. A large central machine, shaped like a rocket, ascends from left to right. This contraption is composed of mundane household objects: a green-and-yellow gas canister at the top, a blue plastic water cooler jug in the middle, a red fire extinguisher, and a clear plastic water bottle attached to a grey metallic base. A white plume of smoke trails from its bottom.

In the lower right, a man wearing a white spacesuit without a helmet floats, his face showing a distressed expression. He is connected to the rocket by a white rope. His helmet floats nearby. 

Legible text includes "MENANTI TERSANGKA BARU KASUS JIWASRAYA", "NASIB REVISI UU INFORMASI TRANSAKSI ELEKTRONIK", and "TEMPO". A large headline reads "KISRUH SATELIT BODONG". A paragraph below explains issues with a Rp 10 triliun satellite procurement. The bottom edge displays date "1-8 MARET 2021", price "RP 45.000", a QR code, and a barcode.
